newsitem.title: MEXICO: North Mexico industry may import gas in '97 - Midcom.
newsitem.headline: North Mexico industry may import gas in '97 - Midcom.

text.p: Industry in the northern Mexico state of Nuevo Leon may import natural gas from the United States in 1997, a gas company director said on Monday.

"We've just received our permit to transport gas in Mexico from the Comision Reguladora so we are here visiting with the industry to determine energy needs," said Andrew Smith, Midcom gas company director.

Mexico's Comision Reguladora de Energia or Energy Regulatory Commission is in charge of liberalising the country's natural gas sector to open up transportation, distribution and storage to the private sector as well as allowing private firms to import gas if they need to.
Midcom has plans to Invest $50 million building a 90-mile gas pipeline from Roma, Texas, to Monterrey, capital of Nuevo Leon State, Smith said.
He added that Midcom aimed to supply half the industrial market for gas in Nuevo Leon, which consumes 400 million cubic feet per day.
